description: TideFlow 1.0.1 - Smarter AI Playlists, Guaranteed Novelty, Non-Blocking YouTube Sync, MIT License & Updater Fixes

changelog.title: AI Assistant & Playlist Engine
items: Fixed playlist playback: Hitting 'Play' or tapping any song now queues and plays the entire AI playlist seamlessly instead of single isolated tracks.
Introduced AiPlaylistQueue with seamless YouTube Radio auto-continuation after playlist finishes.
Guaranteed fresh & new playlist on every request with intelligent non-repetition memory and randomized track selection.
Dedicated separate persistent JSON storage for AI agent memory, user listening preferences, and sessions.
Lightning-fast AI responses powered by NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B.

changelog.title: YouTube Music Synchronization
items: Made YouTube Music sync completely non-blocking, eliminating thread contention and UI stalls.
Automatic background synchronization on startup and login.
Instant force sync trigger when toggled in Account Settings.

changelog.title: App Updater & Licensing
items: Fixed updater version comparison: strictly requires release version to be newer than installed version, preventing false update notifications.
Changed project license to standard MIT License.
Updated branding and visual consistency across all screens.
